text.text_excerpt: BLUF: This is the new pop up in the back of Finn McCool's bar. Definitely good above average bar food. This food cubby hole in the back has changed several times over the past year. Not sure how long this one will stay. Word on the street is they are run by Mopho which is pretty awesome. They have the same wings as Mopho with 2 additional flavors. Absolutely amazing. We got the buffalo and they were awesome. $10 but they are meaty and worth it. I forget the name of the sandwich type thing we got; it is basically a panini but sealed all the way around. I'm not sure; hard to describe. We got the one filled with cheese and figs. It was really good but pretty small and comes with potato chips...

It's an unassuming food window in the back of Finn McCool's, but there's nothing "average bar food" about this place. I would dare to say this is one of the best burgers in NOLA.... double patty, with melted cheddar and a toasted bun. And actually the "Our Token Salad" is really great too. What neighborhood/sports bar have you been to lately that does an impressive salad?! Other highlights on the menu for me are the brussel sprouts with that sauce...whatever it is! YUM. Also the MoPho style wings. Can't say I've ever been to MoPho, but I really enjoy these wings. I've always been happy to have Finn McCool's as a neighborhood spot to watch the game or drink beer with friends, but it's made...

This place has some first class comfort food. My most recent meal was on a cold day and I opted for a pimento cheese and greens sandwich and some thicc fried cheese sticks. The sandwich was crunchy on the outside and warm and gooey in the middle. Actually the same can be said for the cheese sticks. Both were delicious warmed my soul on a cold day. The only thing that could have made that better maybe a tomato soup added to the menu for dipping. Bonus points this place is nestled in one of my favorite neighborhood bars where you can get a stiff drink to go along with munchies.
